labels.note: Table gives Lease Years and approximate MONTHLY rent per RSF. Dates derived from the 2018-11-01 Rent Commencement Date and Section 2.1 (each Lease Year is a consecutive 12-month period); annual psf = monthly psf x 12, which equals annualized base rent / 14,943 for months 8 onward. Months 1-7 rent is computed on only 7,472 RSF (footnote), so the 60.60 for that step is the stated per-RSF rate, not annualized rent / 14,943.
